newsitem.title: USA: United Water, Lyonnaise to own all of JMM.
newsitem.headline: United Water, Lyonnaise to own all of JMM.

text.p: United Water Resources, Lyonnaise American Holding, a U.S. subsidiary of Paris-based Lyonnaise des Eaux, and privately held Montgomery Watson said Monday that they have signed a letter of intent to restructure their ownership interests in JMM Operational Services, which provides operations and management services to municipally-owned water and wastewater treatment facilities.
Currently, the United Water Resources- Lyonnaise des Eaux Partnership owns half of JMM and Montgomery Watson owns the other half.
Under the proposed agreement, United Water and Lyonnaise American Holding would acquire Montgomery Watson's stake in JMM.

No price was disclosed for the transaction, but the company said that after the restructuring is concluded, United Water would have a total investment of approximately $28 million in North America, including both its increased investment in JMM and its additional investments in Canada and Mexico.

The company said that with the recent changes in IRS rulings which allow for longer-term management contracts, it believes this restructuring positions it to help municipal systems meet the challenges of increasing infrastructure costs and water quality regulations through public-private partnerships and contract operations.

The company said that a new organization, operating as United Water Services, will offer a broader range of water-related services, including research and development, and will provide 'one-stop shopping' -- anything from operations and maintenance contracts to full-scale privatization to help municipalities throughout North America cope with emerging water and wastewater challenges.
